messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D mobile-first game where the player can build like in Fortnite, set on a phone/tablet-friendly canvas.

## Requirements
- 3D game playable on phone/tablet with responsive touch controls.
- Core Fortnite-like building: harvest materials, place walls/floors/ramps, defend a core, fight waves.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks; read only latest image.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them at finish.
- User requested "game that you can build like in fortnite (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)".

## Decisions
- Built original game **Riftwright**: 5-wave survival builder around a rift core.
- Static HTML/CSS/JS project served by runtime, with vendored Three.js (`three.module.min.js` + required `three.core.min.js`) and local fonts.
- Gameplay: third-person shooter, left virtual joystick, right-side drag-to-look, hold FIRE, BUILD opens WALL/FLOOR/RAMP tray, PLACE supports hold-to-turbo-build, JUMP.
- Materials: wood/stone/metal cost 10 each; resource nodes harvested by shooting; each material has different structure HP.
- Building: cardinal-snapped placement, ghost preview and validation, floors/ramps physically walkable, walls block player/enemies and can be destroyed.
- AI/enemies: husk, spitter (ranged), brute, boss; waves auto-scale; enemies attack core/player/walls; projectiles and player hitscan with aim assist.
- Performance: disabled real-time shadows automatically when a software renderer (SwiftShader/llvmpipe) is detected; simplified sky shader; dt clamp raised to 0.075; reduced core light/halo; added `low-fx` class.
- Start screen includes FIELD MANUAL panel, control instructions, sound toggle, start/game-over/pause overlays.
- Visual style: twilight magenta/cyan low-poly island, glowing rift core, grid floor, stylized character/structures.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project structure and all main files created.
- Full menu, HUD, build tray, pause/end overlays, responsive CSS, loading state implemented.
- Complete Three.js world: sky, floating islands, rift ring, grid island, core, resources, player model, enemy models, motes, ambience.
- Complete gameplay loop: 5 waves, spawns, core/player health, wave countdowns, material harvesting, building, enemies, projectiles, victory/defeat scores.
- Audio system synthesized with Web Audio (ambient drone, shot/build/hit/wave/victory/defeat).
- Started local server on port 3002 via tmux session `rift`; static server responds 200.
- Verified portrait menu and gameplay screenshots; verified building and combat spawn/aim/fire.
- Fixed missing `three.core.min.js`; fixed raycaster Sprite errors by setting `raycaster.camera` and disabling raycast on resource sprites/markers.
- Tuned enemy visibility (brighter body/emissive, aura sprite, back runes), core brightness, joystick visibility, toast spacing, tutorial toast timing.
- Latest screenshot captured: `screenshots/menu-landscape.jpg` (844×390); needs inspection/assessment.

### Active
- Visual QA of landscape menu screenshot and landscape gameplay.
- Need broader playtest: build validation, floor/ramp traversal, resource harvesting, wave clear/victory, pause/restart, mobile touch layout.
- Need final screenshots and last-pass polish.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/menu-landscape.jpg`; adjust menu composition/title/scene framing if needed.
2. Test landscape gameplay at 844×390; verify HUD, controls, build tray, buttons don't overlap.
3. Test actual pointer/touch interactions: joystick, drag look, FIRE, BUILD, PLACE, JUMP, piece/material selection.
4. Test resource harvesting by shooting a node; confirm material gain and node respawn.
5. Test placing multiple walls/floors/ramps, walk ramp/floor, confirm enemies attack walls and core.
6. Run through a wave to clear, then victory/defeat/restart flows; check console errors.
7. Fix any found bugs; re-check portrait/landscape screenshots.
8. Optionally scale UI up for tablet/desktop (`min-width:900px`) and confirm README/final note.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: full DOM/HUD/menu/build tray/overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all visual styling/responsive layout/animations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: game state, input, waves, AI, building, shooting, HUD, loop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: Three.js scene/island/core/player/enemy/resource models and environment.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/effects.js`: particle pool, tracers, flash/ring effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: procedural Web Audio soundscape.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.min.js`: Three.js entry module.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.core.min.js`: required dependency of vendored Three.js.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/fonts/`: Outfit/Space Grotesk local fonts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: generated visual QA images.

## Important Context
- Local server running at `http://localhost:3002` in tmux session `rift`; `start.sh` uses runtime server.

- Known concern: enemies read as dark purple blobs with pale horns from behind; may need further silhouette/feedback polish.
- Known concern: menu landscape title/scene framing not yet assessed.
- Files are uncommitted in git; repository had only initial scaffold files before this work.
